title: Genealogical document: book
description: A transcript of one archive file: its description, who transcribed it and under which licence, and its parts with their records. Genealogical Document Spec 1.x. SPEC.md lists the rules a schema cannot express.

spec.description: Version of this spec the document follows, as MAJOR.MINOR.

id.description: Identifier of the document, unique within a collection. A published document's file is named <id>.json. It should not change once published.

place.description: The place the book belongs to, at whatever scale fits all of it: a village, a town, a county, a province.

archive.description: Where the original is kept, when it is kept in an archive. Left out for a document that belongs to no archive (a letter in a family's hands).

title.description: Short title: what the book records and when.

description.description: What the book is, in a sentence or two.

yearFrom.description: First year the book covers. Must not be after yearTo.

language.description: Languages the source is written in, as BCP 47 tags, main one first (e.g. ["uk", "cu"]).

authors.description: The people or organisations who made the transcript, the main author first.

email.description: Address at which the author can be reached about the transcript.

role.description: transcriber: made the reading; reviewer: checked it against the scans; editor: prepared it for publication.

license.description: Terms under which the transcript may be used: an SPDX licence identifier ("CC-BY-4.0", "CC0-1.0"), or "LicenseRef-<name>" for any other terms, with licenseUrl.

licenseUrl.description: Where the licence text is. Required when license is a LicenseRef-.

generator.description: The tool or model that produced the machine reading, if one did.

scanSource.description: Where the scans named by the records come from and what their ids look like. Without it a scan id is the name of an image file kept beside the document, without the extension.

url.description: Address of the collection, film or file the scans belong to.

idPattern.description: Regular expression every scan id of the document must match in full. Use only syntax that means the same in ECMAScript and Python.

urlTemplate.description: Address of one scan, with {id} where the scan id goes.

createdAt.description: Day the transcript was made, as YYYY-MM-DD. Set once.

updatedAt.description: Day a reading in the transcript was last changed, as YYYY-MM-DD. Must not be before createdAt.

parts.description: The parts of the book, in display order, at least one. Part ids must be unique.

part.description: A run of records that share a field list: the births of a parish register, the one table of a civil register.

id.description: Identifier of the part, unique within the book. It should not change once published.

place.description: The village, town or city this part belongs to, when it is not the book's: one parish of a volume that binds several together.

yearFrom.description: First year this part covers, when it covers fewer years than the book. Given together with yearTo; both lie within the book's years.

yearTo.description: Last year this part covers. Not before yearFrom.

status.description: draft: a machine reading no person has checked; done: every record of the part checked against its scan by a person.

fields.description: The fields this part's records carry, in display order. The first is a record's headline. Keys must be unique within the part, and every label of the book must be given in the same languages.

label.description: The field's label, keyed by BCP 47 language tag.

records.description: The part's entries, in the order of the source.
